question: Which handymen have done work in zip 75214 and have an opening of at least 2 hours in the next 3 days?
derivation: Derived from the raw data pack by a separate pass that never read the implementation. Handymen = the 8 profiles whose trades include handyman; CRM accounts join to profiles on normalized 10-digit phone, so the old-name Jobber account (Big D Handyman) and Lakewood Home Repair are one provider. 'Done work in 75214' = at least one completed job at a 75214 property (CSV rows without a zip get it from the reference street when the street exists in exactly one zip). Openings use the crew-aware availability model (decision D-041): capacity = min(profile crew_size, max concurrent bookings observed in the provider's history), minimum 1; a time is open when concurrent busy items < capacity. Busy = CRM scheduled jobs and estimates, limbo or unscheduled items with a start (1 h when there is no end), calendar job, personal, all-day and recurring events (TENTATIVE counts, CXL and TRANSPARENT do not), and CSV future rows not already on the calendar. Openings are clipped to declared hours inside the window [2026-11-02 00:00, 2026-11-05 00:00) America/Chicago. Result: 7 of the 8 handymen qualify; Uptown Odd Jobs has openings but no completed 75214 work.
tolerance: The provider set must match exactly (names compared case- and punctuation-insensitively, legal suffixes such as Co/LLC ignored; any listed alias counts as that provider, and a provider listed twice fails). Each listed provider needs at least one opening of >= minMinutes inside the window, and every opening needs a confidence. Exact opening boundaries are not compared: referenceOpenings are examples from the derivation and are reported as notes. For Ray's Fix-It (crew 1, so capacity 1) no opening may overlap the busy intervals listed; his TENTATIVE Wednesday hold may count as busy or not, so it is not listed.
